newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade brisk at $69 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade brisk at $69 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher than last week, USDA said. Inquiry and demand good.

Sales confirmed on 23,500 slaughter steers and 22,500 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 57,000 head confirmed including 7,200 head or about 13 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1300 lbs mostly 1150-1200 lbs 69.00; pen Select with end Choice 68.00; few Select and Choice 1200 lb Holsteins 61.00. Dressed basis - few Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1225 lbs 111.00, hot weights, delivered.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 950-1175 lbs
mostly 1000-1075 lbs 68.00 to mostly 69.00. Dressed basis -
Confirmed - 46,000 last week - none last year - none
Wk to date - 57,000 last week - 4,200 last year - 2,000
